tools.name: find_fax_number
tools.description: Use this when the person is faxing an IRS office and doesn’t have its fax number. Finds the fax number of the IRS office that takes a form or a notice, from XipFax’s list of offices, read from the IRS’s own pages. Give the form or the notice by its name or number alone, such as Form 2848, SS-4 or CP

tools.name: quote_fax
tools.description: Use this when the person asks what a fax costs, or before a fax they’ll pay for is sent. The price of sending one fax of a number of pages with XipFax, without a plan, from XipFax’s price list.

tools.name: send_fax_link
tools.description: Use this when the person would rather add their pages and send the fax on XipFax’s own send screen than sign in to XipFax here. A link that opens XipFax’s send screen with the fax number filled in: an office by its office_id from find_fax_number, or a fax number in the United States, its territories

tools.name: send_fax
tools.description: Use this when the person’s pages are on their draft and they want the fax sent. Sends the person’s XipFax draft to a fax number in the United States, its territories or Canada, or to an office by its office_id from find_fax_number. Give document_ids, as finish_fax_file gave them, in the order you ad

tools.name: get_fax
tools.description: Use this when the person asks how a fax went, or about a fax they received. How a fax of the person’s went, by its id, as send_fax gave it: whether it is sending and how far it has got, delivered, or failed and why, and when it is tried again, with its pages, its price and its times. Answers a fax t

tools.name: get_fax_confirmation
tools.description: Use this when the person needs proof that a fax they sent was delivered, to keep or to pass on. The confirmation of a fax the person sent that was delivered: one page that says who received how many pages, from whom and when, which they can pass on. Answers a link that reads it, as a PDF, for a few

tools.name: add_fax_file
tools.description: Use this when the person’s file is on their own disk, where you can run commands. Puts a PDF from the person’s own disk on their XipFax draft. A photo of any kind, such as a JPEG, PNG, HEIC, WebP, GIF or AVIF, goes as a PDF made from it first on their computer, upright as a photo viewer shows it: on

tools.name: finish_fax_file
tools.description: Use this once the file’s PUT to the address add_fax_file gave has answered 200. Asks XipFax to read the file back and count its pages. Answers the document, ready to send, with its pages; refused where the file never arrived, is locked or unreadable, or takes the fax past the pages a fax may hold. G

tools.name: add_fax_file_from_url
tools.description: Use this when the person’s PDF is at a public link. Puts a PDF at a public address on the person’s XipFax draft: XipFax fetches it from the link, which must answer with the PDF itself, and reads its pages. Answers the document, ready to send, with its pages; refused, saying why, where XipFax can’t f

tools.name: add_fax_file_link
tools.description: Use this when you can’t reach the person’s file or pass it to add_fax_file, such as one on their phone or one attached to this chat. Gives an address where the person adds their pages to their XipFax draft from their own browser, PDFs or photos, with no sign-in there. Give the address to the person

tools.name: finish_fax_file_link
tools.description: Use this once the person says they’re done adding their pages at the address add_fax_file_link gave. Answers the documents it put on their draft, ready to send, with their pages. Until they’ve pressed “Done adding pages” there, added is false, there are no documents, and ask says what to ask of them

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: add_fax_file_from_url · Private data: add_fax_file, finish_fax_file, add_fax_file_from_url, add_fax_file_link, finish_fax_file_link · Public sink: send_fax_link, send_fax, add_fax_file, finish_fax_file, add_fax_file_from_url, finish_fax_file_link · Destructive: add_fax_file.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: add_fax_file_from_url · Private data: add_fax_file, finish_fax_file, add_fax_file_from_url, add_fax_file_link, finish_fax_file_link · Public sink: send_fax_link, send_fax, add_fax_file, finish_fax_file, add_fax_file_from_url, finish_fax_file_link · Destructive: add_fax_file

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_fax_number" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Finds the fax number of the IRS office that takes a form or a notice, from XipFax’s list of offices, read from the IRS’s own pages. Give the form or the notice by its name or number alone, such as Form 2848, SS-4 or CP2000. Where the IRS gives a number for each state, give the place too." → after: "Use this when the person is faxing an IRS office and doesn’t have its fax number. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
